 Versus

Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. T.A. Khan, Senior Advocate assisted by 
Ms. Sheeba Ahmed, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Rahul Verma, Additional Advocate 
General with Mr. Suyash Pant, Standing Counsel 
for the State.
2. Mr. Aman Jot Singh Chaddha, Advocate,
submits that he proposes to file an application 
seeking impleadment in this writ petition, as the 
wife and daughter of the deceased have been 
disinherited from the property.
3. In such view of the matter, adjourned to 
10.08.2026. State Counsel may also file counter 
affidavit in the meantime.
4. Till then only, no coercive action shall be 
taken against petitioner pursuant to impugned 
rejection order dated 20.05.2025.
5. Personal presence of Sub-Registrar, 
Kashipur, is dispensed with for future dates of 
hearing. 
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
